OTP

Product·by @bollmann0x·2026-08-19·inspora page·original post

What it is

OTP: an iPhone sign-in flow topped by a 'WELCOME' doormat illustration lying in a doorway with light spilling in - a slow light sheen sweeps across the door/doormat between states; Sign in collects phone number (+1 dropdown, Continue button), then transitions to 'Confirm Your Number' showing the sent-to number and 6 empty OTP boxes with Confirm; number pad implied.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: an OTP sign-in flow topped by a "WELCOME" doormat illustration lying in a doorway with light spilling in. Sign in collects a phone number (+1 dropdown, Continue); a slow light sheen sweeps the doormat as the form validates; then the screen transitions to "Confirm Your Number" with the sent-to number and 6 OTP boxes.

## Stack
React + TypeScript + Tailwind + Framer Motion (screen transition). Sheen as a translated gradient masked to the header image. Animate transform and opacity only.

## Scene
Header (persists across both screens): white paneled door, brown WELCOME doormat, light spilling in. Screen 1: "Sign in" title, phone field with +1 flag picker, black Continue pill, "Don't have an account? Sign up". Screen 2: "Confirm Your Number", "Enter the code sent to +1 723 4567890", 6 OTP boxes (first focused with rounded border), Confirm button.

## Motion spec
Pattern: two-screen form flow with an ambient sheen.
- Sheen: a soft light sweep plays left-to-right across the door image (1.2s ease-in-out) as the form validates.
- Transition: screens slide/crossfade (400ms); the doormat header persists untouched across the swap.
- OTP: boxes auto-advance focus on digit entry; focused box gets a rounded border emphasis (120ms).

## Calibration
- Sheen 1.2s once per validation - it reads as "checking", not decoration; don't loop it.
- Transition 400ms with the header as the visual anchor (continuity trick).
- OTP boxes: mono digits, generous size, one focus ring color.

## Reduced motion
Sheen skipped; screens crossfade 150ms.

## Don't miss
- The doormat header is the brand moment and survives the transition unchanged.
- The sent-to number renders inside the confirm copy ("sent to +1 723 4567890").
- First OTP box is already focused on arrival - zero taps to start typing.
